purpose: Bound repository working-set growth by separating admission, workbench, maintenance, and operator-attention lanes.

admission.evidence: closing-keyword link (Fixes/Closes/Resolves #N) to an admitted issue, or explicit pull_request_numbers entry

maintenance.standing: author identity only; labels refine cohorts and never grant maintenance standing

control_plane.exemption: only when every changed file is a control-plane path; mixed changes require admission

notes: Issue 378 is seeded because PRIORITY_QUEUE.md already marks Q-TEMPORAL-DISSOLUTION-01 as the global GATING architectural repair.
Admission determines working-set standing only. It does not ratify governance, approve code, or authorize merge.
When admitted ready-for-review work exceeds capacity, the coordinator does not choose winners; it reports capacity contention for operator resolution.

The gate reads this file from the default branch (pull_request_target). A PR cannot admit itself by editing this file, and touching a control-plane file alongside feature work does not exempt the feature work.
Two ready PRs linking the same admitted objective are both held (DUPLICATE_ACTIVE_IMPLEMENTATION); the coordinator does not choose a winner.

PR #514 is admitted explicitly (Z2 instruction, 2026-09-25): it carries the coordinator control plane together with regenerated tool-manifest files, so it is a mixed change under the control-plane rule and needs an explicit admission record rather than an exemption.
